title: Worried pupil's message and reply frame
subject: Arabic
unit: Summer 1: School: what school is like (3.1)
source: Written for arabic/y10 lesson 52 (Pupil PDF worksheet: worried pupil's message and reply frame)
intro: Lesson 52: Pressures at school. Read the ideas from the lesson, then do the tasks.

arabic.text: أَنَا قَلِقٌ جِدًّا مِنَ الامْتِحَانَاتِ. عِنْدِي ثَمَانِيَةُ امْتِحَانَاتٍ فِي شَهْرِ مَايُو، وَلَا أَعْرِفُ مِنْ أَيْنَ أَبْدَأُ. لَا أَنَامُ جَيِّدًا، وَأَقْضِي سَاعَاتٍ طَوِيلَةً عَلَى هَاتِفِي. أَشْعُرُ أَنَّ كُلَّ أَصْدِقَائِي أَذْكَى مِنِّي. مَاذَا أَفْعَلُ؟ سَامِي

questions.a: He has eight exams in May and does not know where to start.
He does not sleep well; he spends hours on his phone; he feels his friends are cleverer.

frame.label: أَخِي العَزِيزَ سَامِي،
frame.prompt: Show you understand how he feels

arabic.text: فَإِنَّ مَعَ العُسْرِ يُسْرًا ۝ إِنَّ مَعَ العُسْرِ يُسْرًا: For indeed, with hardship comes ease. Indeed, with hardship comes ease.

questions.q: Give advice to a friend who revises all night.
questions.a: For example: يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تَنَامَ مُبَكِّرًا وَأَنْ تُرَاجِعَ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ قَلِيلًا

questions.q: Reply to a worried pupil's message (our own text on the pupil PDF) in the portal response box (about 100 words): show understanding, give three pieces of advice with different structures, and end with an encouraging Islamic reminder. Start: أَخِي العَزِيزَ / أُخْتِي العَزِيزَةَ ...
questions.a: Empathy, three advice structures with subjunctive after أَنْ, an encouraging close (for example 94:5-6)

questions.q: Extend: Group B: answer aloud: كَيْفَ تَتَعَامَلُ مَعَ الضَّغْطِ؟
questions.a: A developed spoken answer with two strategies
A) يَنْبَغِي أَنْ تَنَامَ جَيِّدًا. After أَنْ: fathah.

questions.q: Think again: what helps under pressure?
questions.a: Planning, rest, talking to someone, du'a and salah
